transcript.text: theres water in the bottom of my frige under the salad draws, keeps comming back after i mop it up

Water pooling under the salad drawers in a fridge-freezer is almost always caused by a blocked defrost drain. During its automatic defrost cycles, water forms on the back wall and should run down a small channel into a tray at the bottom of the appliance (usually near the motor) where it evaporates. If that drain hole gets clogged with food debris or ice, the water has nowhere to go but onto the floor of your fridge. 1. Locate the small drain hole at the bottom of the back wall inside the fresh food compartment.
2. Check if it looks blocked by gunk or ice.
3. If you can see blockage, try clearing it gently with warm water (using a turkey baster or squeezy bottle) and a soft pipe cleaner or cotton bud. Could you tell me: is that drain hole currently blocked, frozen solid, or does it look clear?
ah ok i didnt know there was a hole! ill have a look. is it ok if i just do it with a cotton bud, i can have a go. also water is only inside the fridge not near the plug or anything

Yes, using a cotton bud is perfectly fine for that. Just be gentle so you don't push debris further down. If it looks stubbornly blocked or icy, pouring a little warm water into the hole afterwards helps flush it through. The fact that the water stays inside the fridge compartment and doesn't leak near the plug suggests this is an internal drainage issue rather than an external leak from the back of the appliance. The most likely cause is still that small drain hole at the bottom of the back wall being blocked, which stops defrost water from escaping to the tray outside. Could you tell me: when you look at that drain hole, is it blocked with gunk or ice, frozen solid (so you can't clear it), or does it look completely clear?
ok i had a look and theres a little groove and a hole at the bottom of the back wall, its got bits of lettuce and gunk in it. il clear it with a cotton bud and some warm water now

That sounds like exactly what’s causing the problem. The lettuce and gunk were blocking the path for defrost water to leave the fridge compartment. Please go ahead and clear it gently with the cotton bud and flush it through with warm water. If you can, pour a little more warm water into the hole afterwards to make sure it flows all the way down to the drip tray at the back of the appliance (usually near the motor). Once that’s done, let me know: is the drain hole now clear and draining freely? Also, please keep an eye on the bottom of the fridge over the next 24 hours. If you stop seeing water pooling there after clearing it, we can consider this fixed.
done! i cleared it with the cotton bud and warm water and the water went straight down the hole. ill keep an eye on it

Before you start, switch it off and unplug it. That’s excellent news. Since the water is draining freely now, that blockage was most likely the cause. To help stop it happening again, try to keep food containers away from the back wall of the fridge so they don't trap debris in the drain channel, and wipe up any spills promptly. If you find the water returning after a day or two despite the clear drain, let me know—we can check if there's an issue with the drip tray at the back or the door seal. Otherwise, I hope that sorts it out completely!
